claim: The KDS data plane API limits apply per shard. PutRecord has a call limit of 1000 TPS, and each shard can support writes of up to 1,000 records per second.

evidence.quote: | PutRecord | 1000 TPS | Each shard can support writes up to 1,000 records per second, up to a maximum data write total of 10MiB per second. |  Kinesis is designed to handle intermittent large records (1-10MiB in size) using burst capacity. |

evidence.quote: The following section describes the limits for the KDS data plane APIs. KDS data plane APIs enable you to use your data streams for collecting and processing data records in real time. These limits apply per shard within your data streams.
